# ThreadSanitizer suppressions for the thread-sanitizer CI job
# (.github/scripts/check-tsan.sh). Keep each entry to one named cause.

# SwiftNIO's bridge from an EventLoopFuture to async/await
# (EventLoopFuture.get(), NIOCore/AsyncAwaitSupport.swift) resumes an
# UnsafeContinuation on the event loop's thread. The report pairs that
# resume's read of the awaiting task's frame with the same task's write of
# its next continuation into the same slot, made after it was resumed. The
# resume orders the two, through the Swift runtime, which is not built with
# the sanitizer, so it does not see the order. Seen on main at 52efea40 and
# 51f435af, from NodeRuntime.start awaiting Ivy's start.
race:EventLoopFuture.get
